text: So this is the free AI system that sweeps through my entire iCloud email, filters out spam, unsubscribes for me, and then texts me the important stuff for me to review. It starts out here with a Python script that flags the past senders based on their behavior and decides whether or not it's important for me to view. Then once it's decided, it routes each email to its relevant folder. So I have a folder for receipts, I have a folder for click-up team notifications, I have a folder for new AI strategies to implement, and it loops until the inbox is clean. Then all the inbound email leads are automatically added to my click-up and enriched by another agent. So right now it's running the COO, I have other agents to enrich my leads. Then it identifies if the contents of the business newsletter are relevant to me, and if they are, it adds the important information to my agent network brain right here. And this is what all the agents use to see what others have done is to constantly improve and learn over time. Next, for all the emails that are classified as spam, which is my favorite feature, it actually goes in and unsubscribes for me. And this feature alone is probably the biggest time saver of this entire system. And then lastly, it sends a message to my phone with any important business or personal emails that I actually need to review personally. And honestly, this saves me like 15 hours per week, and every single day this whole system just runs completely on autopilot. And if you want to set this up for yourself, just comment system and I can send you the file and the scripts that I use. Again, it's completely free and it works with any AI you prefer to use.
